status: RESEARCH ONLY; explicit conference proxy NOT measured recruiting talent
purpose: Conference-weighted four unit rankings to reflect uneven player talent concentration, before player-specific recruiting data exists
formula: adjusted PO,RO,PD,RD = original unit metric + conference adjustment; offensive strength and defensive strength each also receive the same adjustment, with ranks reranked across 136 teams
warnings: Conference category is an explicit talent proxy, not verified recruiting-rating measurements.
